WordPress LMS plugin is a powerful, user-friendly, lightweight LMS plugin that transforms your site into a complete online education platform.
You can easily manage courses, quizzes, and progress tracking to keep learners engaged and motivated making it an easy LMS for any user.

Fox LMS is a WordPress learning management system (LMS plugin) that allows you to transform learning experience through flexible course creation options.
It’s an all-in-one online learning management system with a built-in course builder. It is designed to help you deliver an engaging learning experience right from your WordPress site including student and instructor dashboards.
WordPress LMS as an elearning plugin, helps you get up and running fast without sacrificing quality thanks to its straightforward course and lessons management.

Powerful e-learning platform

Use the potential of your online learning platform with the LMS plugin for WordPress offering full Gutenberg and Elementor support, along with intuitive blocks for courses to structure your lessons easily.
If you’re on the hunt for the modern LMS plugin, Fox LMS plugin is definitely worth checking out.
This e learning lms is designed to turn your WordPress website into a complete powerful e-learning platform, providing everything you need to create, manage, and deliver engaging online courses.

The WordPress LMS plugin free version, makes it accessible for those just starting their e-learning journey.

Various features available in the plugin, such as certificate building, quizzes will take your e-learning platform to the next level.
Experience the perfect blend of simplicity, functionality, and flexibility with the great LMS plugin for WordPress.

Unlike many other WordPress LMS systems, this one keeps things user-friendly and letting learners track course progress.
It’s hands down one of the magnificent course plugins for WordPress thanks to its course editor.

You can easily connect PayPal Integration to your courses. It will allow you to accept secure payments directly through PayPal, simplifying student enrollment and user registration.

Advanced Quiz Maker

Keep your learners motivated with the WordPress LMS plugin’s quiz integration.
This feature allows you to add quizzes directly into your video lessons, creating an interactive course quiz experience. In case you’re testing knowledge, reinforcing key concepts, or providing practice opportunities, quizzes are a great way to track progress and keep students engaged.
With customizable question types, scoring options, and feedback tools, you can create an advanced quiz using the quiz builder.

You will need to get the WordPress Quiz Maker and create various quizzes based on your lessons.

LMS Course Examples with Quiz

It’s a great tool to align quizzes with your course goals, making it a powerful addition to your WordPress learning management system.

With the WordPress eLearning plugin, you’re not only creating an online course but building a complete learning environment.
It’s an excellent learning management system for WordPress, giving you everything you need, from a student dashboard to automated certificates, to deliver a seamless experience.

Analytics

With WordPress LMS plugin, you can understand your learners and improve your courses with the WordPress LMS plugin’s advanced analytics feature. Track student progress and monitor course performance across multi-instructor courses.
With detailed reports on engagement, completion rates, and learner activity in the academy plugin you can identify what’s working and where improvements are needed.
Use this data to refine your content, enhance the learning experience, and ensure your platform’s success.

With support for multiple instructors, flexible courses, and easy ways to sell, it’s a great WP Courses LMS solution for any teaching style.
The WordPress training course plugin is designed to help you create a fully customized WordPress LMS, giving you insights into how to optimize your courses for better learning outcomes and create LMS in WordPress in minutes..

The top WordPress LMS gives you in-depth insights into student progress, course performance, and overall engagement. With this LMS WP plugin, you can track learner activity, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions to improve your courses.
Whether you’re using a WP LMS plugin for a single course or managing an entire LMS WordPress website, these analytics tools help you measure success and highlight areas for growth.
For more advanced features upgrade to WordPress LMS Pro and enjoy the process of creating a better learning platform on WordPress.

| PRO | DEMO | DOCUMENTATION |

Questions and Answers (Q&A)

The Q&A option available in the course builder plugin allows the instructors and students to interact directly, ask questions, and get answers inside WordPress LMS platform.
This Q&A system part of a beginner friendly LMS, is designed to improve communication, boost engagement, and build a stronger learning community within your eLearning platform.
Instructors can provide support, clarify lessons, and create discussions that make learning more engaging. Meanwhile the students can also benefit from answers given to others, helping them learn faster and stay motivated.

Annoucements

Course creators can send announcements directly inside your WordPress LMS, using the lesson builder keeping students informed about new lessons, course changes, upcoming events, or deadlines.
The announcements feature in this simple LMS helps instructors and course creators instantly share important updates with their learners. Make sure learners never miss essential information.
Create stronger relationships with your learners whether in corporate training or standard courses, and create a more organized online classroom environment.

External services

Fox LMS interacts with a few third-party services to provide essential functionality such as payment processing, and user analytics. During plugin activation or uninstallation, the plugin communicates with https://poll-plugin.com/fox-lms/ to track usage and handle user interactions.
For payments, Fox LMS integrates with PayPal, using both the sandbox (https://sandbox.paypal.com/sdk/js, https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com) and live environments (https://www.paypal.com/sdk/js, https://api-m.paypal.com) to securely process course purchases.

Additionally, Fox LMS includes user behavior tracking through Microsoft Clarity (https://www.clarity.ms/tag/) to monitor engagement and improve the user experience. Tracking only begins after the user gives permission. If the user cancels or declines, no tracking is performed.

sections.installation:
There are two ways to install the WordPress LMS Plugin: either directly through your WordPress dashboard or by downloading the ZIP file from WordPress.org. Let’s explore both methods in detail.

Let’s begin with the easiest way to install Fox LMS WP plugin:

  • Sign in to your WordPress dashboard.
  • Navigate to the Plugins section in the left-hand menu.
  • Click the Add New button at the top.
  • Type “Fox LMS” into the search bar.
  • Hit the Install Now button.

That’s it. Installing the Fox LMS plugin on WordPress is quick and easy. Now, let’s look at the second method for installing the plugin:

  • First of all, download the ZIP file from https://wordpress.org/plugins/fox-lms/ by clicking the Download button.
  • Once the file is downloaded, go to the Plugins section in your WordPress Dashboard.
  • Click on Add New, then select Upload Plugin.
  • Choose the fox-lms.zip file by clicking Choose File, or simply drag and drop it into the upload area.
  • Finally, click the Install button.

That’s it! Now you are ready to have your own LMS platform with the WordPress LMS plugin.
sections.faq:
Is there a user guide or any documentation available?

Of course! Take a look at the User Manual to explore all the features the plugin offers. It includes descriptions of the options, usage instructions, detailed video tutorials, installation guides, and more.
If you have any questions or need support, feel free to contact our support team through the FREE support forum provided.

Who can I contact for support?

If you have questions, need assistance, or want to report any issues, feel free to post in our official support forum on WordPress. You can also reach out to us directly through our contact page.

Where should I report issues or submit contributions?

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions to improve the WordPress LMS plugin, we’d love to hear from you!

You can report bugs, request features, or share your feedback directly through our official WordPress Support Forum.

Is it possible to connect my courses with Quiz Maker?

Yes! The FoxLMS plugin includes Quiz Maker, so you can easily create different exams with a clear scoring system.

Are users and instructors able to sign up on my LMS platform?

Yes, instructors and users are able to register on your LMS platform. To enable it, simply insert the relevant shortcode from the Pages section.

Does FoxLMS require any fees or take a percentage of my course earnings?

No, FoxLMS does not take any share of your course earnings.

Is the FoxLMS plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the FoxLMS plugin works perfectly on mobile devices. Its responsive design ensures a great user experience on smartphones and tablets, allowing learners to access courses and use the platform from any device.

Can I translate FoxLMS plugin?

Absolutely, you can! This WordPress lms plugin is fully translatable.
You can use the Loco Translate WordPress plugin, trusted by hundreds of our clients, to handle translations. For more details, feel free to check out the helpful article.

Is the Pro version a one-time purchase, or will I need to renew the license?

For the WordPress LMS plugin, we offer both options for the Pro version.
You can make a one-time purchase and enjoy access to the Pro features forever. Also, you can have a yearly subscription that includes updates and support for 12 months, with the option to renew each year.

External services

Fox LMS interacts with a few third-party services to provide essential functionality such as payment processing, and user analytics. During plugin activation or uninstallation, the plugin communicates with https://poll-plugin.com/fox-lms/ to track usage and handle user interactions.
For payments, Fox LMS integrates with PayPal, using both the sandbox (https://sandbox.paypal.com/sdk/js, https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com) and live environments (https://www.paypal.com/sdk/js, https://api-m.paypal.com) to securely process course purchases.

Additionally, Fox LMS includes user behavior tracking through Microsoft Clarity (https://www.clarity.ms/tag/) to monitor engagement and improve the user experience. Tracking only begins after the user gives permission. If the user cancels or declines, no tracking is performed.
